A romantic design with double the charm, these heart-in-heart studs are set in rose vermeil gold and surrounded by a radiant halo of lab-grown diamonds. The openwork layers add depth and brilliance, making them an exquisite choice for bridal elegance or love-filled celebrations.

Specifications

  • Metal: 18K Vermeil Gold
  • Color: Rose Gold
  • Weight: 2.506g
  • Diamonds: 52
  • Diamond weight: 0.53 carat

title: Rubis Lumière Studs
descriptionHtml:
Timeless elegance radiates from these rose vermeil gold studs, centred with a striking emerald-cut ruby toned stones and framed by a brilliant cluster of lab-grown diamonds. A refined silhouette that exudes grace and colour-rich sophistication, ideal for heirloom-inspired soirées or evening elegance.

Specifications

  • Metal: 18K Vermeil Gold
  • Color: Rose Gold
  • Weight: 3.288g
  • Diamonds: 16
  • Diamond weight: 0.94 carat

title: Trueheart Studs
descriptionHtml:
A minimal yet endearing take on modern romance, these vermeil gold earrings are sculpted into petite heart shapes, each centered with a bezel-set lab-grown diamond that seems to float in its warm blush bed. The high-polish finish enhances the sweet curves and soft volume, making them perfect for everyday wear with just the right amount of sparkle. Whether styled solo or layered with other studs, they lend a gentle radiance to your look.

Specifications

  • Metal: 18K Vermeil Gold
  • Color: Rose Gold
  • Weight: 1.629g
  • Diamonds: 2
  • Diamond weight: 0.11 carat
